greet.speaker: Arcane Duelist
greet.text: Runes drift lazily around a dagger's edge. "The muscle-bound rounds are over. Now it gets interesting."
greet.text_zh: 符文懶洋洋地繞著匕首刀刃打轉。「靠蠻力的回合結束了。現在才要開始有趣。」

already_won.speaker: Arcane Duelist
already_won.text: "Hm. Better than I expected. The Champion won't go as easy on you as I did."
already_won.text_zh: 「嗯，比我預期的好。王者可不會像我這樣手下留情。」
